row.principle_en: Narrow within-layer bottlenecks reduce computation tensors, while the teacher transfers knowledge through aligned inter-layer representations.
row.principle_zh: 层内窄瓶颈缩小计算张量，教师通过对齐的层间表示迁移知识。
row.problem_en: Deep, thin networks are difficult to train
row.problem_zh: 深而窄的网络难以直接训练
row.step_1_en: Design a 24-layer student with intra-block width 128 and inter-block width 512
row.step_1_zh: 设计24层学生：层内128、层间512的瓶颈接口
row.step_2_en: Use an IB-BERT teacher with matching 512-dimensional interfaces
row.step_2_zh: 用IB-BERT教师将层间特征对齐到512维
row.step_3_en: Transfer inter-block features and attention distributions, then export the student
row.step_3_zh: 迁移层间特征及注意力分布，再导出学生
row.title_zh: MobileBERT：瓶颈结构与逐层迁移
row.tradeoff_en: Inter-block features remain wider; inspect bottleneck and additional-operation costs in the deployment graph
row.tradeoff_zh: 层间表示仍较宽；瓶颈与额外算子成本须按部署图核对

row.principle_en: Deploy the compact student and train using intermediate and prediction supervision
row.principle_zh: 以紧凑学生承载推理，用中间层与预测监督辅助训练
row.problem_en: Preserve task quality after shrinking the student
row.problem_zh: 缩小学生结构后保留任务能力
row.step_1_en: Set a four-layer student: hidden width 312, FFN width 1200
row.step_1_zh: 设置4层学生：隐藏维312、FFN维1200
row.step_2_en: Map teacher layers using g(m)=3m and project hidden states for alignment
row.step_2_zh: 用g(m)=3m映射教师层，并以投影对齐隐藏维
row.step_3_en: Run general distillation, then task-specific intermediate and prediction distillation
row.step_3_zh: 先通用蒸馏，再按任务蒸馏中间层与预测
row.title_en: TinyBERT: shallow, narrow student with staged supervision
row.title_zh: TinyBERT：浅窄学生与分阶段监督
row.tradeoff_en: Requires training and task data; check size savings separately from quality gains
row.tradeoff_zh: 需训练与任务数据；张量尺寸节省和质量收益分别核对

row.principle_en: Project K and V along the sequence axis with E and F to k, producing n×k attention
row.principle_zh: 沿序列维以E、F投影K、V到k，计算n×k注意力
row.problem_en: Full attention intermediates grow quadratically
row.problem_zh: 完整注意力中间量随序列长度平方增长
row.step_1_zh: 训练序列投影矩阵
row.step_2_en: Form projected K=EK and V=FV while retaining n queries
row.step_2_zh: 计算压缩K=EK、V=FV，保留n个Query
row.step_3_en: Compute attention and aggregation in compressed space
row.step_3_zh: 在压缩空间求注意力并聚合
row.title_zh: Linformer：学习序列维投影
row.tradeoff_en: The choice of k affects approximation quality and execution cost. The architecture requires training, and causal-decoding compatibility needs separate evaluation.
row.tradeoff_zh: k 决定近似质量与执行成本；需要训练调整结构，因果解码的适用性另行验证。

row.principle_en: Approximate attention with n×m, m×m and m×n factors, then aggregate V directly
row.principle_zh: 用n×m、m×m与m×n三因子近似注意力，并直接聚合V
row.problem_en: Preserve sequence relationships with fewer landmarks
row.problem_zh: 在较少landmark下保存主要序列关系
row.step_1_en: Construct Q/K landmarks using segment means
row.step_1_zh: 用分段均值构造Q/K landmark
row.step_2_en: Iteratively approximate the pseudoinverse of the landmark-to-landmark softmax core
row.step_2_zh: 求landmark间softmax核心矩阵的迭代伪逆
row.step_3_en: Multiply by V through the factor chain
row.step_3_zh: 依次与V相乘，保留因子链
row.title_zh: Nyströmformer：landmark近似
row.tradeoff_en: Landmark count and pseudoinverse stability affect quality and overhead
row.tradeoff_zh: landmark数与伪逆稳定性影响质量和开销

row.principle_en: QuaRot uses invariant rotations; SpinQuant learns rotations with a different preparation budget.
row.principle_zh: QuaRot 使用计算不变旋转；SpinQuant 学习旋转，二者准备预算不同。
row.problem_en: Reduce axis-concentrated activation outliers.
row.problem_zh: 减少坐标轴集中的大幅激活对量化的影响。
row.step_1_zh: 选择计算等价的变换位置
row.step_2_en: Apply or learn rotations
row.step_2_zh: 应用或学习旋转
row.step_3_en: Quantize and include online transforms
row.step_3_zh: 量化表示并计入在线变换
row.title_zh: 旋转分散离群值 · QuaRot / SpinQuant
row.tradeoff_en: Account separately for transforms absorbed into weights and rotations executed online. Joint W/A/KV quantization is one configuration, so its gains cannot be counted again for each object label.
row.tradeoff_zh: 分别统计可融入权重的变换和在线旋转成本。W/A/KV 联合量化是一套配置，其效果不能按对象标签重复累加。

row.principle_en: Migrate quantization difficulty from activations to weights through equivalent scaling.
row.principle_zh: 把部分量化难度由激活迁移给权重，再做联合权重/激活量化。
row.problem_en: Mitigate activation-outlier quantization error.
row.problem_zh: 缓解激活离群值造成的低精度误差。
row.step_1_zh: 统计通道激活范围
row.step_2_en: Absorb equivalent scales into weights
row.step_2_zh: 求等价缩放并吸收到权重
row.step_3_en: Quantize jointly and execute
row.step_3_zh: 联合量化并使用低精度核
row.title_zh: 等价通道缩放 · SmoothQuant
row.tradeoff_en: Check joint W/A error and scales; hardware results are platform-specific.
row.tradeoff_zh: W/A 联合误差与尺度必须同时核对；论文硬件结果不能跨平台沿用。

row.principle_en: Select salient tokens by attention, then cluster by Key similarity and merge information.
row.principle_zh: 先以注意力选择关键 token，再依据 Key 相似性聚类并合并信息。
row.problem_en: Preserve supplementary information while reducing visual tokens.
row.problem_zh: 减少视觉 token 时保留被删表示中的补充信息。
row.step_1_zh: 注意力选择关键视觉 token
row.step_2_en: Form Key-similarity neighborhoods
row.step_2_zh: 按 Key 相似性形成邻域
row.step_3_en: Merge information into retained tokens
row.step_3_zh: 把补充信息合入保留 token
row.title_zh: 选择与信息合并 · LLaVA-PruMerge
row.tradeoff_en: This combines selection and merging; report matching and aggregation costs.
row.tradeoff_zh: 这是剪枝与合并的组合，不是纯删除；匹配与聚合成本单列。

row.principle_en: Use image-related text to score visual tokens, prune progressively and recycle information.
row.principle_zh: 用与图像相关的文本表征指导视觉 token 评分，逐层裁减并回收部分信息。
row.problem_en: Reduce downstream computation for irrelevant visual tokens.
row.problem_zh: 减少不相关视觉 token 的后续计算。
row.step_1_zh: 识别与视觉任务相关的文本
row.step_2_en: Score visual tokens
row.step_2_zh: 计算视觉 token 相关性
row.step_3_en: Prune progressively and recycle
row.step_3_zh: 逐层裁减并回收表示
row.title_zh: 文本引导的视觉选择 · SparseVLM
row.tradeoff_en: Visual-language-specific; account for scoring and fine-grained information loss.
row.tradeoff_zh: 限定视觉语言模型；评分开销与细粒度信息损失必须核对。

row.principle_en: Cache a low-rank KV latent plus a shared RoPE key and train with KL(teacher‖student) for recovery
row.principle_zh: 保存低秩KV潜变量和共享RoPE键，以KL(P教师‖P学生)训练恢复
row.problem_en: Convert pretrained attention under a fixed cache budget
row.problem_zh: 在给定缓存预算下转换已有注意力
row.step_1_en: Set KV rank and initialize from joint SVD of concatenated [WK,WV]
row.step_1_zh: 设定KV秩，对拼接的[WK,WV]做联合SVD初始化
row.step_2_en: Handle the shared RoPE key and latent cache
row.step_2_zh: 处理共享RoPE键与潜变量缓存
row.step_3_en: Distill outputs and record DPO as a separate stage
row.step_3_zh: 进行输出蒸馏，再单列DPO阶段
row.title_en: Fixed-rank MLA: explicit per-layer cache budget
row.title_zh: 固定秩MLA：明确每层缓存预算
row.tradeoff_en: A uniform budget aids planning; disclose training cost and per-task degradation
row.tradeoff_zh: 统一预算易规划，但训练成本与各任务退化仍需披露

row.principle_en: Select per-layer ranks using cumulative squared-singular-value energy, then apply teacher supervision
row.principle_zh: 按累计奇异值平方能量阈值逐层选秩，再进行教师监督
row.problem_en: Layers differ in low-rank sensitivity
row.problem_zh: 不同层的低秩敏感度不一致
row.step_1_en: Decompose per-layer Q and joint K/V weights
row.step_1_zh: 分解各层Q及联合K/V权重
row.step_2_en: Choose per-layer ranks from energy thresholds
row.step_2_zh: 依能量阈值确定各层秩
row.step_3_en: Check quality and execution under cache constraints
row.step_3_zh: 同缓存约束下核对质量与执行成本
row.title_zh: 动态秩MLA：按层选择保留能量
row.tradeoff_en: Different per-layer shapes complicate layouts and operator planning
row.tradeoff_zh: 层间形状不同增加布局与算子规划复杂度

row.principle_en: Cache a joint K/V latent with a decoupled positional branch; absorb some up-projections.
row.principle_zh: 缓存 K/V 联合低秩 latent，并使用解耦的位置编码分支；部分上投影可吸收。
row.problem_en: Reduce per-token cache through a co-designed attention architecture.
row.problem_zh: 通过配套注意力架构减少每 token 缓存表示。
row.step_1_zh: 联合下投影形成 latent
row.step_2_en: Cache latent and positional branches
row.step_2_zh: 缓存 latent 与 RoPE 分支
row.step_3_en: Execute the matching attention projections
row.step_3_zh: 用配套注意力投影完成计算
row.title_zh: 原生低秩注意力 · MLA
row.tradeoff_en: Requires a matching trained architecture and includes positional Keys.
row.tradeoff_zh: 需要配套训练结构；计入 RoPE key，不能当冻结模型的通用开关。

row.principle_en: Factorize relevant projections using activation-aware approximation, specifying cached factors and reconstruction.
row.principle_zh: 对相关投影作激活感知低秩分解，需说明实际缓存因子与恢复路径。
row.problem_en: Reduce KV representation dimensions through projection factorization.
row.problem_zh: 通过投影矩阵分解降低 KV 表示维度。
row.step_1_zh: 统计相关投影的输入分布
row.step_2_en: Set Key/Value rank budgets
row.step_2_zh: 确定 Key/Value 低秩预算
row.step_3_en: Integrate compact caches with compatible reads and computation
row.step_3_zh: 接入低维缓存及配套读取和计算过程
row.title_zh: 事后投影低秩分解 · ASVD
row.tradeoff_en: Weight factorization alone is insufficient; require evidence for cached tensors and execution.
row.tradeoff_zh: 普通权重分解不能自动计作 KV 压缩；缓存张量与执行路径必须有证据。

row.principle_en: Quantize Keys per channel and Values per token, retaining a high-precision residual.
row.principle_zh: Key 按通道、Value 按 token 分组，保留高精度 residual 区承接新 token。
row.problem_en: Retain low-bit quality under different Key and Value distributions.
row.problem_zh: 兼顾 Key 与 Value 不同分布下的低比特质量。
row.step_1_zh: 分析 K/V 分布并设定粒度
row.step_2_en: Append tokens to a residual buffer
row.step_2_zh: 新 token 进入高精度残留区
row.step_3_en: Quantize completed groups and read
row.step_3_zh: 满足分组后压缩并供 attention 读取
row.title_zh: K/V 非对称量化 · KIVI
row.tradeoff_en: Total cache storage includes scales, zero points, high-precision residuals and packing, not just a nominal 2-bit representation.
row.tradeoff_zh: 总缓存开销应包含尺度、零点、高精度残留与打包，不能仅按 2-bit 估算。

row.principle_en: Estimate Key inner products through random projections and sign sketches.
row.principle_zh: 利用随机投影与符号 sketch 估计 Key 内积，区别于直接标量量化。
row.problem_en: Approximate attention inner products with compact Key representations.
row.problem_zh: 以更紧凑的 Key 表示近似注意力内积。
row.step_1_zh: 构造共享随机投影
row.step_2_en: Store Key sketches and statistics
row.step_2_zh: 缓存 Key 的符号与所需统计
row.step_3_en: Estimate query inner products
row.step_3_zh: 从 sketch 估计查询内积
row.title_en: Random projection and sign sketches · QJL
row.title_zh: 随机投影与符号 sketch · QJL
row.tradeoff_en: The 1-bit label concerns Key sketches; include Values, norms and projections.
row.tradeoff_zh: 标题 1-bit 指 Key sketch；Value、范数与投影成本另计。

row.principle_en: Prune channels using Query-Key contributions; retain full recent Keys and mask historical Keys consistently.
row.principle_zh: 按 Query-Key 交互贡献裁减通道；保留近期 Key 的完整维度，历史段用一致掩码。
row.problem_en: Reduce lower-contribution channels of historical Keys.
row.problem_zh: 缩减历史 Key 的低贡献特征通道。
row.step_1_zh: 评估 Query-Key 通道贡献
row.step_2_en: Mask historical Key channels
row.step_2_zh: 为历史 Key 建立裁减掩码
row.step_3_en: Compute masked and full segments
row.step_3_zh: 分段计算裁减与完整查询得分
row.title_zh: 查询引导的 Key 通道裁减 · ThinK
row.tradeoff_en: Distinct from eviction and low-rank factorization; separate combined quantization effects.
row.tradeoff_zh: 不是历史 token 驱逐，也不是低秩分解；与量化组合的效果需拆分归因。

row.principle_en: Train a smaller student with reverse KL and on-policy optimization.
row.principle_zh: 用反向 KL 与在策略优化学习较小学生，部署阶段使用学生模型。
row.problem_en: Reduce a smaller student model’s overestimation of low-probability regions in the teacher distribution.
row.problem_zh: 减少小型学生模型对教师低概率区域的过度估计。
row.step_1_zh: 定义学生结构与教师监督
row.step_2_en: Optimize reverse KL on student generations
row.step_2_zh: 采样学生生成并优化反向 KL
row.step_3_en: Deploy and compare matched students
row.step_3_zh: 部署学生并比较同结构基线
row.title_zh: 生成分布蒸馏 · MiniLLM
row.tradeoff_en: Student architecture determines model size. Evaluate teacher access and training costs separately, and check which capabilities are retained.
row.tradeoff_zh: 模型大小由学生结构决定。需单独评估教师访问和训练成本，并检查各项能力能否保留。

row.principle_en: Transform weights with activation statistics and allocate rank by sensitivity.
row.principle_zh: 用激活统计变换权重，再按层敏感度分配低秩预算。
row.problem_en: Make weight approximation sensitive to actual inputs.
row.problem_zh: 让权重近似反映真实输入的重要方向。
row.step_1_zh: 收集输入激活分布
row.step_2_en: Transform and factorize weights
row.step_2_zh: 变换权重并进行 SVD
row.step_3_en: Allocate ranks and replace factors
row.step_3_zh: 选择层秩并替换为低秩因子
row.title_zh: 激活感知分解 · ASVD
row.tradeoff_en: The compressed target is weights, not the calibration activations.
row.tradeoff_zh: 压缩目标是权重；输入含激活不等于直接压缩激活。

row.principle_en: Combine truncation-aware whitening, sequential approximation and parameter updates.
row.principle_zh: 采用截断感知白化、顺序低秩近似与参数更新处理累积误差。
row.problem_en: Reduce truncation output error and recover model quality.
row.problem_zh: 降低低秩截断的输出误差并恢复模型质量。
row.step_1_zh: 统计输入并进行白化
row.step_2_en: Truncate under rank budgets
row.step_2_zh: 按预算截断奇异方向
row.step_3_en: Update sequentially and check quality
row.step_3_zh: 顺序更新并核对恢复质量
row.title_zh: 截断感知白化 · SVD-LLM
row.tradeoff_en: Account for whitening, updates and intermediate tensors; recovery has costs.
row.tradeoff_zh: 白化、恢复更新及中间张量成本需列出；完整流程不能全部标为免训练。

row.principle_en: Fisher-weighted asymmetric output alignment is followed by refreshed statistics and a rank-constrained natural-gradient/SVD correction; the quantized backbone stays fixed.
row.principle_zh: 先用Fisher加权的非对称输出目标求低秩对齐，再重新测量统计量，用自然梯度与截断SVD校正残余误差。主体量化格式不变，输出额外叠加一个低秩支路。
row.problem_en: A frozen quantized backbone still has output residuals. Weight-only fitting or a second-order-only objective can misallocate a small rank budget.
row.problem_zh: 量化主体已固定，但仍有输出残差；只拟合权重差或只看二阶项，可能把有限的补偿秩用在不重要的误差方向。
row.step_1_en: Freeze quantized weights and form residuals using floating-point and actual quantized paths.
row.step_1_zh: 冻结量化权重，对比浮点输入/输出与实际量化路径，构造非对称残差。
row.step_2_en: Solve for a rank-64 adapter using Fisher weighting and truncated SVD.
row.step_2_zh: 用Fisher加权和截断SVD求rank-64低秩适配器。
row.step_3_en: Refresh statistics on the compensated model and replace the adapter without increasing its final rank.
row.step_3_zh: 在补偿后的模型上重测统计量，校正并替换适配器，保持最终秩不变。
row.title_en: Align, Then Correct: align and correct outputs after quantization
row.title_zh: Align, Then Correct：量化后，用低秩支路对齐并补偿输出
row.tradeoff_en: If W4 saves capacity but narrowly misses the quality target, compare higher precision in sensitive layers with low-rank compensation, including latency and preparation costs. The paper’s 4-bit result motivates reproduction; it does not establish acceptance on Ascend.
row.tradeoff_zh: 若 W4 已节省容量，但质量略低于要求，可比较保留敏感层高精度与低秩补偿的质量、时延代价。新增 FP16 支路和统计成本均需计入；论文的 4-bit 结果为复现提供依据，尚不能证明昇腾业务已达标。

row.principle_en: Use representative inputs to identify salient channels; scale weights up and corresponding inputs down, preserving their product before quantization. Quantize the transformed weights rather than simply retain FP16 exceptions.
row.principle_zh: 先用代表样本找出影响较大的通道，再把这些通道的权重放大、输入相应缩小，量化前的乘积保持不变。随后量化权重，以减小重要通道的误差；并非简单地把重要权重留在FP16。
row.problem_en: Large input channels amplify the same weight error. Weight magnitude alone may identify the wrong features to protect.
row.problem_zh: 有些输入通道的数值较大，同样的权重误差会在这些通道造成更大的输出偏差。只按权重大小判断重要性，可能选错保护对象。
row.step_1_en: Collect representative layer inputs and channel activation statistics.
row.step_1_zh: 缓存代表样本的层输入，计算输入通道的激活统计。
row.step_2_en: Search scaling and clipping using quantized layer-output error without whole-model recovery training.
row.step_2_zh: 搜索缩放与裁剪参数，以量化后的层输出差异选择候选；不做全模型恢复训练。
row.step_3_en: Fold equivalent transforms where possible, quantize with supported grouping, and pack weights for the runtime.
row.step_3_zh: 将等价变换尽量融入相邻层，按后端支持的分组编码、打包并接入权重量化核。
row.title_zh: AWQ：优先保护影响大的权重通道
row.tradeoff_en: Use as an initial W4 quality candidate. Port offline scale search/folding and confirm export layouts; TinyChat CUDA kernels are not an Ascend implementation. Verify quality and execution separately.
row.tradeoff_zh: 优先作为W4质量候选：先迁移离线scale搜索与折叠，再核对导出布局。TinyChat的CUDA核不能直接作为昇腾实现；质量和执行两条链分别确认。

row.principle_en: DSQ alternates row and column scales for down-projection; DAC corrects mean drift at LayerNorm and refreshes inputs blockwise. Correcting activations does not mean using 2-bit activations.
row.principle_zh: DSQ交替优化行、列两组尺度，缓解下投影量化难度；DAC在LayerNorm处校正量化引起的均值偏移，并逐块更新校准输入。校正激活不表示把激活降到2-bit。
row.problem_en: FFN down-projection has difficult row and column distributions. Upstream quantization shifts later inputs, weakening calibration against the original activations.
row.problem_zh: FFN下投影的行列分布难同时兼顾；前层量化还会改变后层输入，单层使用原始输入校准可能低估累计误差。
row.step_1_en: Inspect down-projection error and input mean drift against floating-point blocks.
row.step_1_zh: 比较浮点与量化块输出，检查下投影及输入均值偏移。
row.step_2_en: Correct normalization drift and alternate down-projection scales.
row.step_2_zh: 校正归一化处的偏移，交替优化下投影行列尺度。
row.step_3_en: Fold compatible scales upstream and refresh later calibration inputs.
row.step_3_zh: 将可折叠尺度并入前层，用量化块更新下一块校准输入。
row.title_en: D²Quant: dual scales for down-projection and activation drift correction
row.title_zh: D²Quant：双尺度处理下投影，校正激活均值偏移
row.tradeoff_en: A 2026 frontier candidate for diagnosing accumulated error. Its 2-bit result does not establish business quality loss below 1%; test the mechanisms before claiming Ascend gains.
row.tradeoff_zh: 2026年前沿研究候选，用来解释和定位误差累积；论文2-bit质量尚不足以直接满足<1%业务门槛。先做机制消融，不承诺昇腾收益。

row.principle_en: Rounding weights changes layer outputs. GPTQ uses calibration inputs to estimate error relationships, then adjusts unquantized weights after quantizing a subset. This preparation is offline.
row.principle_zh: 一个权重被舍入后，会使整层输出发生偏差。GPTQ利用校准输入估计误差之间的关系，量化一部分权重后，调整尚未量化的权重来补偿偏差。这些准备离线完成，推理时不再求解这些统计量。
row.problem_en: Independent rounding accumulates layer-output error; magnitude alone does not express error sensitivity.
row.problem_zh: 独立地将每个权重舍入，会累积层输出误差；权重间的误差敏感性不能只用数值大小解释。
row.step_1_en: Collect X, form XXᵀ statistics, and damp for numerical stability.
row.step_1_zh: 收集层输入X，形成XXᵀ统计，并用阻尼处理数值稳定性。
row.step_2_en: Use Cholesky-based information to quantize columns or blocks and compensate remaining weights.
row.step_2_zh: 用近似二阶信息（Hessian）描述误差敏感性，通过Cholesky分解稳定计算补偿量，再分块量化并更新剩余权重。
row.step_3_en: Export weights, group scales and required ordering; verify backend format support.
row.step_3_zh: 导出量化权重、分组尺度及所需排列；核对目标后端是否接受该格式。
row.title_en: GPTQ: compensate output error while quantizing
row.title_zh: GPTQ：边量化，边补偿造成的输出误差
row.tradeoff_en: Match AWQ conditions to test second-order compensation on business inputs. The current msModelSlim GPTQ processor documents INT8; a W4 NPU execution path is not presumed.
row.tradeoff_zh: 与AWQ同条件比较，以判断二阶补偿是否更适合业务分布。当前msModelSlim GPTQ processor仅列INT8，不能预设GPTQ-W4已具备NPU执行链路。

row.principle_en: Randomized Hadamard processing spreads concentrated values; encode multiple weights together using vector-codebook entries, with fine-tuning for quality recovery. A codebook stores predefined vectors, referenced through indices.
row.principle_zh: 先用随机Hadamard变换分散集中在少数位置的数值，再把多个权重一起编码为向量码本中的条目；还可通过微调恢复质量。码本就是一组预先定义的向量，保存条目编号来替代逐个保存权重。
row.problem_en: Reduce representation error at very low precision.
row.problem_zh: 在极低比特区间降低表示误差。
row.step_1_en: Spread concentrated values using randomized Hadamard transforms.
row.step_1_zh: 用随机Hadamard变换分散集中大值，减轻少数位置难表示的问题。
row.step_2_en: Map weight groups to E8 vector-codebook entries and store their indices.
row.step_2_zh: 将一组权重映射到E8向量码本，保存条目编号。
row.step_3_en: Apply the recovery-tuning recipe and a codebook-consuming kernel.
row.step_3_zh: 按论文方案做恢复微调，并接入能读取码本的专用核。
row.title_en: QuIP#: transforms and vector codebooks for lower precision
row.title_zh: QuIP#：用变换和向量码本探索更低位宽
row.tradeoff_en: Include codebook, decoding, transforms and fine-tuning costs.
row.tradeoff_zh: 码本存储与解码、变换和微调预算需计入，不能与免微调方案混算。

row.principle_en: Optimize rounding and scales against block-output reconstruction. DeltaLoss guides precision allocation under a bit budget. Test learned rounding and mixed precision in separate ablations.
row.principle_zh: 用块输出重建优化舍入与尺度；以DeltaLoss估计层敏感度，支持在平均位宽约束下分配精度。优化舍入和混合位宽是两项可分别消融的变化。
row.problem_en: Rounding direction and layer sensitivity differ. Uniform precision can spend the budget on insensitive layers.
row.problem_zh: 同一位宽下，不同舍入方向的影响不同；所有层使用统一精度，也可能把预算花在不敏感的层。
row.step_1_en: Estimate sensitivity with calibration data and fix the business evaluation.
row.step_1_zh: 用校准集估计敏感度，先固定业务质量评测口径。
row.step_2_en: Optimize rounding/scales at fixed precision and record preparation cost.
row.step_2_zh: 固定一种位宽，优化舍入与尺度，记录校准及优化预算。
row.step_3_en: Then test higher precision for sensitive layers within supported runtime formats.
row.step_3_zh: 再比较敏感层提位宽的增益，并核对后端支持的配置。
row.title_en: SignRoundV2 / AutoRound: learned rounding and layer-aware precision
row.title_zh: SignRoundV2 / AutoRound：优化舍入，按层分配精度
row.tradeoff_en: Consider when basic W4 quality fails and offline optimization is affordable. Mixed precision needs executable kernels; better simulated quality does not establish faster serving.
row.tradeoff_zh: 适合基础W4质量不足、且允许额外离线优化预算的情况。混合位宽必须有可执行核和调度支持；更好的伪量化质量不等于更快。

row.principle_en: Use approximate second-order reconstruction to compensate pruning error.
row.principle_zh: 利用近似二阶重建选择并补偿被删权重造成的误差。
row.problem_en: Control layer-output deviation when pruning weights.
row.problem_zh: 移除权重时尽量控制层输出偏差。
row.step_1_zh: 记录校准层输入
row.step_2_en: Set the sparsity pattern
row.step_2_zh: 确定目标稀疏模式
row.step_3_en: Prune and reconstruct
row.step_3_zh: 剪枝并重建保留权重
row.title_zh: 逐层重建补偿 · SparseGPT
row.tradeoff_en: Unstructured zeros do not guarantee speed; check storage and kernel support.
row.tradeoff_zh: 非结构化零值不保证加速；稀疏模式、存储和核支持另行核对。

row.principle_en: Score weight magnitude times input activation magnitude, selecting per output channel.
row.principle_zh: 以权重幅值乘输入激活幅值评分，按输出通道保留或删除权重。
row.problem_en: Identify lower-contribution connections with a simple score.
row.problem_zh: 以简单评分识别低贡献连接。
row.step_1_zh: 采集输入激活统计
row.step_2_en: Compute importance scores
row.step_2_zh: 计算连接重要性分数
row.step_3_en: Prune under channel/pattern budgets
row.step_3_zh: 按输出通道与模式预算剪枝
row.title_zh: 幅值与激活评分 · Wanda
row.tradeoff_en: Use matched sparsity and calibration conditions when comparing reconstruction methods. Avoiding weight updates does not mean calibration data is unnecessary.
row.tradeoff_zh: 与重建方法比较时，应使用相同稀疏率和校准条件。不更新权重并不意味着无需校准数据。
